plans.title: Custom Training Plan
plans.description: A living curriculum built from your reviewed moves, recurring weaknesses, chosen training goal, phase, opening, rating, and clock.
plans.outcome: Work first on the decisions that cost you most, while preserving the purpose of the sessions you chose to play.

plans.title: Calculation & Tactical Vision
plans.description: Build a reliable checks-captures-threats scan, compare candidate moves, and calculate forcing lines without moving the pieces.
plans.outcome: Recognize tactical motifs faster and calculate the opponent’s best reply before committing.

plans.title: Pawn Play & Structures
plans.description: Understand pawn chains, breaks, isolated and hanging pawns, passed pawns, weak squares, and the endgames created by pawn decisions.
plans.outcome: Treat every pawn move as a permanent structural decision and choose breaks that improve your pieces.

plans.title: Piece Activity & Coordination
plans.description: Improve the least active piece, coordinate forces, use open files and outposts, and understand favorable bishop-versus-knight imbalances.
plans.outcome: Make every piece contribute before launching an attack or changing the pawn structure.

plans.title: Prophylaxis & Opponent Awareness
plans.description: Identify the opponent’s idea before executing your own plan, restrict counterplay, and distinguish active from passive prevention.
plans.outcome: Ask what changes after your move and stop threats before they become forcing.

plans.title: King Safety & Attacking Play
plans.description: Recognize mating patterns, exposed kings, attacking batteries, sacrifices, defensive necessities, and the moment an attack becomes forcing.
plans.outcome: Balance ambition with king safety and calculate attacks through the opponent’s strongest defense.

plans.title: Defense & Resourcefulness
plans.description: Find only moves, neutralize threats, return material when necessary, and preserve difficult positions through active defensive resources.
plans.outcome: Respond to the opponent’s strongest idea rather than defending against an imagined threat.

plans.title: Positional Planning & Evaluation
plans.description: Evaluate king safety, material, activity, pawn structure, space, and weak squares before choosing a plan.
plans.outcome: Turn a position assessment into a concrete sequence of improving moves.

plans.title: Endgame Technique
plans.description: Train king activity, opposition, pawn races, rook technique, zugzwang, promotion, and essential theoretical positions.
plans.outcome: Convert basic advantages and defend standard endings with repeatable technique.

plans.title: Conversion & Simplification
plans.description: Preserve an advantage, exchange the right pieces, reduce counterplay, and choose favorable transitions into technical endings.
plans.outcome: Trade counterplay rather than trading automatically, and verify that the resulting ending still favors you.

plans.title: Opening Plans & Transitions
plans.description: Learn development, central control, recurring structures, thematic breaks, and the plans that remain after memorized opening moves end.
plans.outcome: Reach familiar middlegames with a plan instead of relying only on move memory.
